# function: mobiletargeting_journey_execution_activity_metrics

Builds the ARN of an `mobiletargeting` `journey-execution-activity-metrics`:

```
arn:${Partition}:mobiletargeting:${Region}:${Account}:apps/${AppId}/journeys/${JourneyId}/activities/${JourneyActivityId}/execution-metrics
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
mobiletargeting_journey_execution_activity_metrics(app_id string, journey_id string, journey_activity_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `app_id` (String) Value for `${AppId}` in the ARN template.
1. `journey_id` (String) Value for `${JourneyId}` in the ARN template.
1. `journey_activity_id` (String) Value for `${JourneyActivityId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
